 Too many groups to keep tabs on? Fear not, this is your one-stop guide to all the information you need to know about every upcoming comeback.
 Photo: Kevin Winter/ Staff/ Getty Images Entertainment/ Getty Images By  Nicole Ng and Natalie Hoe  -  published 22 Oct 2026 
 There’s only one thing we look forward to more than an upcoming concert and it’s, well... an upcoming comeback.
 In the 2000s, household names in the K-pop music industry like BIGBANG , Girls Generation and 2NE1 kickstarted the Hallyu wave. But it’s arguably only in the past seven years or so that K-pop has seeped into the global mainstream—notably thanks to artists like BTS , BLACKPINK , Stray Kids , and SEVENTEEN , to name a few. Now, the question is no longer “Who are they?” but “Who doesn’t know them?” 
 Korean acts have been lighting up stages on an international level, topping global charts and sparking a phenomenon. This comeback season, mark your calendars because a plethora of groups—both rookies and veterans—are coming back, and they’re not waiting for anyone. Get ready to stan all over again.

 Confirmed Returns
 23 October 2026: LISA - Press Play 
 LISA is far from done when it comes to dropping bangers. The multitalented star released her lead single, “SaWaDiKa” on 3 September, where she showcased her Thai heritage through her powerful dance moves. Come 23 October, she will be dropping Press Play , her new EP with six tracks. We can’t wait for the rest of the album to hit our playlists.
 26 October 2026: RIIZE - EMOTIION 
 RIIZE surprised fans with not one, but two comeback announcements at their third-anniversary fanmeeting last month. The group plans to release a new digital single on 26 October, followed by their second full-length album EMOTIION in early to mid 2027. With hits like “Bag Bad Back” and “Fame”, in their discography, this comeback looks set to be yet another banger.
 26 October 2026: illit - Break Even 
 Raise your hands if you’ve been obsessed with Illit’s music this year, with “It’s Me” and “Iconic By Mistake” going platinum on your playlists. The group is coming back with their fifth mini album Break Even, featuring four tracks. The comeback teases a more emotional and bold angle, a stark change for the group. Nonetheless, we’re strapped in for this emotional roller coaster we’re about to ride.
 Related article: Best Upcoming K-dramas In 2026: Release Dates And Where To Stream 
 28 October 2026: XLOV - i=! 
 Following the end of the Asia leg of their world tour, XLOV ’s dropping their third mini-album i=! . The mini album is to feature eight tracks, with two unit tracks. i=! builds on the previous album’s chess-inspired concept. With another intriguing theme in store, we’re curious to see where they take the story next.
 4 November 2026: RESCENE - Pulse 
 RESCENE has been making waves with their remake of Kara’s iconic “Pretty Girl”, and we’re hooked. The girl group is already on their way to their fourth mini-album, Pulse. Although not much information has been provided yet, we are predicting this new album to be filled with a sense of refreshing whimsy.
 16 November 2026: Tomrrow X Together - Perfect Storm 
 Tomorrow X Together announced their return with their ninth mini-album Perfect Storm this November. The comeback is set to happen shortly after the group kicks off their new tour, Steal The Wind, accompanied with six exciting tracks.
